postconditions.expression: output == 'In with a chance' if input_string.strip() and (input_string.startswith('07') or input_string.startswith('+44')) and input_string.replace('-', '').isdigit() and len(input_string.replace('-', '')) == 11 else output == 'Plenty more fish in the sea'
postconditions.description: The output is 'In with a chance' if the input string is a valid British mobile phone number, otherwise it is 'Plenty more fish in the sea'.
